published.source: Shaman regear round (2026-10-23): requests rebuilt from the presets with the natural flask zone

summary: The default Elemental build with Mana Tide Totem for the group, cast at 10% mana.
rotation: Pre-pull: Lightning Shield at -5.4s, Mana Spring Totem at -3.9s, Lightning Bolt at -2.9s (lands 0.1s after the pull), Searing Totem at -0.9s
Elemental Mastery and the other cooldowns (Sapper, Demonic Rune, Major Mana Potion, Land Mine) as they come up
Mana Tide Totem at 10% mana or less
Mana Spring Totem when it is down, Mana Tide is not up and at least 20s remain
Searing Totem when it is down and at least 20s remain
Flame Shock whenever its DoT is down and at least 9s remain
Lava Burst on cooldown, unless Flame Shock would run out before the cast ends
Earth Shock once a Lightning Bolt would no longer land before the fight ends
Lightning Shield when it is down, above 50% mana with at least 60s left (orbs fire at the target on raid damage hits, 2 a minute)
Lightning Bolt rank 10 as filler (no Chain Lightning on one target)
caveats: The Water Shield point does nothing (Lightning Shield stays up).
Lightning Bolt X's base damage is ×1.12, the beta's raise for the top playable rank.
Only the Tier 1 2-piece is active. The 5-piece (Lava Burst -1s cooldown) would add more.
One 2% crit elixir. Owl on top of Sages would add about 10.
Raid damage hits (2 a minute, each fires Lightning Shield) are an estimate.
Eye of the Storm 3 stops 70% of pushback from the 2 raid hits a minute.
Takes the Major Mana Potion where Level 60 takes the Caustic Smog Potion: -4.3 / +1.8 / +27.2 at 120 / 180 / 300 s.
notes: mksettings -spec ele -apl level60_mana_tide (standards 23: every shaman drops its own party totems; the raid has none, the shaman drops Mana Spring Totem itself); edited defaultPotion to MajorManaPotion (the build's own consumes, EncounterLevel60ManaTide); race SkyborneWindshaper (the best race since client 70425's Wind Blessed 3% haste).
